comment: Per-binding native-implementation dashboard. Tracks which program-evaluator-surface features each binding's native path covers vs which routes through the libcx C ABI. The evaluator family is cx_code_eval / cx_code_eval_with_len / cx_code_eval_streaming / cx_code_diagram (spec/abi.md §2.16.1 + §2.16.2). Tier 1 (V / Python / Go) is c-abi-passthrough by design and locked at parity. Tier 2 (Rust / TypeScript) catch up once per release.

v.comment: V is the native reference implementation. cx_code_eval and the entire code/ module live in vcx/code/; every feature is native by definition.

python.comment: Native Python parser for data-bin + AST surfaces; program-eval / diff / hash / canonical via libcx FFI. Arrow + Parquet via pyarrow C-Data bridge. 73/73 cross-binding conformance parity.

go.comment: Native Go parser for data-bin + AST + emitters. Program-eval via cgo + libcx; cgo trampoline (cxGoStreamTrampoline) wired to cx_code_write_cb. 73/73 cross-binding conformance parity.

rust.comment: Native data-bin + AST; everything else routes through libcx FFI via ensure_thread(). Tier 2 catchup: surface migration from cx_eval to cx_code_eval is pending.

typescript.comment: koffi FFI to libcx for most surfaces. Arrow + Parquet via apache-arrow JS IPC bridge (W7 / X6) — composes with libcx C-Data export. Tier 2 catchup: surface migration from cx_eval to cx_code_eval is pending.

csharp.reason: Not in Tier-1 / Tier-2 parity matrix

v0_7_x_native_port_roadmap.comment: v0.7.x / v0.8.0 candidates for native-implementation expansion. Order: data-bin → emitters → cx_code_eval (the latter is large and binding-specific — the v0.7.6 program evaluator is a substantial body of work to port natively). version-literal-ok
priority_order: rust.cx_code_eval surface migration (Tier 2 catchup; FFI signature change, not native port)
typescript.cx_code_eval surface migration (Tier 2 catchup; FFI signature change, not native port)
